abstract: We present a case of an adult female who presented mildly symptomatic and with a history of having a mass removed from her neck as an infant. Radiographic imaging detected the presence of a heterogeneous, encapsulated mass in the parapharyngeal space that was surgically resected, and subsequently pathologically confirmed to be a benign, mature cystic teratoma.
abstract_ja: 本症例は成人女性で、軽度の症状を有し、傍咽頭間隙に不均一で被包性の腫瘤を認めた。患者は乳児期に頸部から腫瘤を摘出された既往があった。画像検査で被包性の腫瘤が検出され、外科的切除後の病理学的検査で良性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認された。
